report.summary: Only the Lambda runtimes page was read. Not read: AWS What's New feed, lifecycle page, and the other groups' pages (Kubernetes, mobile, browsers, security), because they do not apply to a Lambda runtime setting. Node.js 26 is in public preview, so nodejs24.x is the newest GA target. The date used is the block-function-update date (Aug 31, 2027), when deploys stop. The Node.js 18 and Node.js 20 deprecations are already past, so they do not affect this repository.
